summary: Cricket stats involving iconic Indian players and major Bollywood blockbuster announcements consistently generate the highest view counts and engagement. Technical finance news, non-Indian sports updates, and auto launch specs suffer from low viewer interest and should be dropped immediately. Content focus must shift entirely toward fast-paced Indian cricket record breakdowns and big-budget movie lore using crisp Hinglish titles. Refining hooks to deliver maximum visual impact within the first 2 seconds while maintaining seamless end-to-start loops will accelerate subscriber acquisition.
do_more: Double down on Indian cricket stats and record breakdowns featuring icons like Arshdeep Singh, Hardik Pandya, Rohit Sharma, and Virat Kohli
Cover high-budget Indian cinema announcements, star casting reveals, and box-office record milestones
Structure scripts for seamless loop playback with a high-curiosity question near the 35-second mark
avoid: Avoid reporting stock market trends, gold rate movements, and corporate finance news
Stop creating Shorts about general automobile sales figures and technical car launch specifications
Avoid covering niche international sports events that lack a direct connection to famous Indian athletes
Eliminate slow, descriptive intros; state the central shocker or record within the first 2 seconds
